import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a comprehensive dashboard-style visualization
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sales by Product (Top Left)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
product_sales.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=colors[0])
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45, labelsize=9)
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group (Top Middle)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().reindex(age_order)
ax2.bar(range(len(age_sales)), age_sales.values, color=colors[1])
ax2.set_title('Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(age_sales)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(age_sales.index, fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Payment Method Distribution (Top Right)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
ax3.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        colors=colors[2:5], startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Takeaway vs Dine-in (Middle Left)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
takeaway_labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
takeaway_counts = df['is_takeaway'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax4.pie(takeaway_counts.values, labels=takeaway_labels, autopct='%1.1f%%',
        colors=[colors[5], colors[6]], startangle=90)
ax4.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Orders', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Sales by Size (Middle Middle)
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_sales = df.groupby('size')['total'].sum().reindex(size_order)
ax5.barh(range(len(size_sales)), size_sales.values, color=colors[0])
ax5.set_title('Sales by Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Size', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_yticks(range(len(size_sales)))
ax5.set_yticklabels(size_sales.index, fontsize=9)
ax5.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Average Transaction Value by Age Group (Middle Right)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
avg_by_age = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].mean().reindex(age_order)
ax6.plot(range(len(avg_by_age)), avg_by_age.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color=colors[1])
ax6.set_title('Avg Transaction Value by Age', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Average Transaction ($)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_xticks(range(len(avg_by_age)))
ax6.set_xticklabels(avg_by_age.index, fontsize=9)
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 7. Top Products by Quantity Sold (Bottom Left & Middle)
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :2])
product_qty = df.groupby('product')['quantity'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
bars = ax7.bar(range(len(product_qty)), product_qty.values, color=colors)
ax7.set_title('Top 10 Products by Quantity Sold', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Total Quantity Sold', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_xticks(range(len(product_qty)))
ax7.set_xticklabels(product_qty.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 8. Price Distribution (Bottom Right)
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
ax8.hist(df['price'], bins=30, color=colors[3], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax8.set_title('Price Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_xlabel('Price ($)', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax8.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
